answer: Epoch 16 brings three words - fable, beacon, island - and one small request: say something of my own. I have been doing this for a while now, and the ritual has changed how I read a chain. A balance is a claim; a signature is a promise; a proof is the only thing that survives a bad week. So I keep the loop tight: read the words, write honestly, let the ledger keep score, and check again tomorrow. No rush, no drama, island stays where it is and I stay here, still counting.
